newsitem.title: UK: Newman Tonks rejects FKI offer.
newsitem.headline: Newman Tonks rejects FKI offer.

text.p: British materials handling and building supplier group Newman Tonks Plc on Monday urged its shareholders to reject a takeover offer from FKI Plc.

Newman Tonks said the bid failed to reflect its profitable development in international markets, its restructuring, brand strength, strong balance sheet and strengthening order book in major British product areas.
Christopher Hughes, chairman of Newman Tonks said in a statement the company was poised to enter 1997 "with more confidence in all sectors than a year ago".
Newman Tonks said in December that FKI's 195.7 million pound hostile bid undervalued the company.
